FIST.RealNameHint: Only you know this. Reveal it at the perfect dramatic moment.
FIST.RealNameReveal: Click to unmask (only you can see it)

Armor.Label: Armor
Armor.ShatterHint: Destroy {name} to ignore the damage of one attack?

WarDie.Label: War dice
WarDie.SpendHint: Spend a WAR DIE: roll +1D6 and add it to any roll (anyone's).
WarDie.SpentOn: {name} spends a WAR DIE on {target}'s roll
WarDie.Bust: An explosion die showed 1 — the roll becomes 0!

Mission.StartHint: Start a new mission: restore full HP, refill limited-use items and AMMO, and gain per-mission WAR DICE from traits.
Mission.Started: {name} is deployed. Full HP, gear restocked (+{wd} WAR DICE).

Rendezvous.Title: Rendezvous
Rendezvous.Hint: Once per mission the team may send a rendezvous signal. At the safe point, choose one:
Rendezvous.restockHint: Refill one limited-use item or one weapon's AMMO.
Rendezvous.intelHint: Receive one useful fact about the mission.
Rendezvous.IntelRequest: {name} requests INTEL: the referee shares one useful fact about the mission.

Advance.Title: Advance
Advance.Hint: You acted according to your role. Choose one reward:
Advance.DropTrait: Drag a new trait from the Traits Index onto the sheet.

Insertion.Title: Insertion
Insertion.wrong: 6 or less: deployment goes wrong somehow.
Insertion.extra: 10+: deploy with an extra standard issue item.
Insertion.sixes: Double sixes: deploy with an extra standard issue item, and +3 to your first roll.

Death.Message: {name} has fallen. Log them in the character graveyard and prepare an emergency insertion.

Roll.ClickToRoll: Click to roll 2D6 + attribute (Shift: skip dialog)
Roll.Bands: 6- failure · 7-9 partial · 10+ success · double sixes ultra

Outcome.failureText: You don't do what you wanted, and things go wrong somehow.
Outcome.partialText: You do it, but with a cost, compromise, or complication.
Outcome.successText: You do exactly what you wanted, without additional headaches.
Outcome.ultraText: You do exactly what you wanted, with some spectacular added bonus.

Partial.Title: Yes, but...
Partial.ButtonHint: Referee: pick or roll a complication for this partial success
Partial.Hint: Partial success: they get it, with a cost. Roll D66 on the whole table, roll 1D6 in the category that fits the scene, or just click a complication.

general.6: You'll need to rest a moment

mental.5: You don't know why you're right

movement.4: You must take a longer route

social.5: You need to make a hard sell

weird.5: You slowly develop a new trait

Damage.Label: Damage
Damage.ApplyHint: Apply to targeted tokens, subtracting ARMOR
Damage.ApplyRawHint: Apply to targeted tokens, ignoring ARMOR

SuddenDeath.Triggered: Snake eyes! Sudden death: all damage doubled, armor useless, until someone dies.
SuddenDeath.Hint: Sudden death: double damage, ignore armor

Choke.Hint: Roll 1D6: on a result equal to or higher than the CHOKE score, the NPC performs the listed action.

Npc.AttributesHint: Attributes (only if the NPC must roll like a player):

Vehicle.ExplosionHint: When destroyed: X-in-1D6 chance to explode for XD6 DAMAGE (X = ARMOR).

Trait.DropHint: Drag traits from the Traits Index here
Trait.ChooseAttributeHint: This trait grants +{bonus} to an attribute of your choice.
Trait.GrantsHint: Created on the operative when this trait is gained; removed with it. Drop weapons, armor or items here to add.

Role.Label: Role
Role.DropHint: Drag a role from the Roles Index here
Role.TakenHint: {name} already has the {role} role. You can't choose a role someone else already has. Take it anyway?

Weapon.DropHint: Drop weapons here. Only one can be equipped at a time.

Tag.ChooseHint: Weapon tags modify a weapon. Pick one:
Tag.UsageHint: Drop this tag on an operative's weapon (or on a weapon sheet) to attach it.

Item.DeleteGrantedHint: {name} was granted by a trait and is replaced between missions. Delete it anyway?

Adjust.Title: Manual adjustments
Adjust.Hint: Attributes, MAX HP and ARMOR are calculated from traits and gear. Use these only for special cases.

Builder.Title: Making mercs
Builder.RandomMercHint: Roll a random codename, role and two traits? Current traits and role will be replaced.
Builder.SheetIntro: You belong to FIST, a legendary rogue mercenary unit. Every operative starts from the same baseline; traits are the building blocks that make you unique.
Builder.SheetHint: Attributes, ARMOR and MAX HP on this sheet update automatically as you add traits and gear.
Builder.TraitsIntro: Choose two traits from the Traits Index, or roll 2D666. Each trait grants a special skill, an item and a stat modification — all applied automatically.
Builder.TraitsReady: Two traits on file. You can add more later by advancing.
Builder.BonusIntro: Take one: a standard issue item, +1D6 MAX HP, or +1D6 WAR DICE.
Builder.BonusHp: Roll 1D6 and add it to your MAX HP.
Builder.BonusWar: Roll 1D6 and start with that many WAR DICE.
Builder.RoleIntro: Your role is what your character always wants to do — doing it lets them advance. You can't choose a role someone else already has.
Builder.CodenameIntro: Pick a codename that fits who you are and what you do. Also pick a real name, but don't tell anyone — not even the referee — until the perfect dramatic opportunity.

Warn.NoOperative: Select or assign your operative first.
Warn.NoTokens: Target (or select) at least one token.
Warn.NoGM: No GM is connected to apply this to {name}.
Warn.NoAmmo: Out of ammo. Restock at a rendezvous or find more.
Warn.NoWeapon: This character has no weapon to attach the tag to.
Warn.TagExists: That weapon already has this tag.
Warn.NoChoke: This NPC has no CHOKE score.

ammoTracking.name: Optional rule: abstract ammo tracking
ammoTracking.hint: Ranged weapons have AMMO 6; after each attack roll 1D6 to see if it drops (p. 73).

explodingWarDice.name: Optional rule: exploding war dice
explodingWarDice.hint: War dice explode on 6; if an explosion die shows 1, the roll becomes 0 (p. 73).

suddenDeath.name: Optional rule: sudden death
suddenDeath.hint: Snake eyes during combat trigger sudden death: double damage, armor useless (p. 74).

encumbrance.name: Optional rule: encumbrance
encumbrance.hint: Show carried items against MAX HP + FRC or RFX (p. 73).
